test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order and thus form a group. Which of the following letter-cluster pairs does not belong to that group?

(Note: The mismatched letter-cluster pair is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff0d8e32a7e80c8a0f32fe049be66c25ff3158e027f9b919dda98d555ab272f7.png] 

The logic followed here is

1. WC → UL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc6c37f5dd468cc83d65f01ca7ca564d0765e6d5ab1ef00fa0af454915a370fe.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ac9de15d9b796bb7ac91b1085b7d5b5c2a8deb0baee6b872aafeb2924726c5.png] 

2. MS → KB 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5da6e65d23d084c803fbbb20be3c90d53280dff9fece355e3480e1fbf4c58aa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87bfb3a4a93c2f31b9103e02c2bd6232883b24dd0ba65eab7b385cc785f0001a.png] 

**3. DJ → BT **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd11fdbc597bd289b66ea4633c514f66390036c6b0c867940e34d8abebd9203.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4144c1ed602620f82c604ff39039936ee234a9f0e03277471c4b0ab25063f1f2.png] 

Not follow the same pattern

4. TZ → RI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e40dce946af450edc418e8293bc447b158937ed3f7cb0033d796f6495d65fbc2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e055c5020d19436432a1ee1aeaaf1a9f930d06aa8ee41d81038dc0427fd40b27.png] 

Thus, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is DJ - BT.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
